headline: 🔴 Lazarus AFD.sys zero-day joins KEV with full Dream Job teardown, 🐳 Docker Sandboxes escape flaws disclosed, ⛓️ Brevo Cloudflare-edge supply chain documented, 🐧 public root PoCs for four Linux kernel flaws, 🎬 MovieReaper runs C2 over Solana, 💸 Revolut extortion hits $3M Monero demand
summary: The day's defining development is CISA's KEV listing of Lazarus' AFD.sys Windows zero-day alongside Check Point's full Operation Dream Job teardown, flanked by Sansec's documentation of the Brevo Cloudflare-edge supply-chain attack and working public exploits for four Linux kernel privilege escalation flaws. Patch urgency clusters on Docker Sandboxes 0.42.0, Orkes Conductor 3.30.2, GitLab 19.3.2 and Unbound 1.26.1, with the Cisco ISE and Acronis KEV deadlines landing September 19.
